column1: # derivation: §4.6: strings order by their UTF-8 bytes, and a prefix sorts
# before its extension. g = 1 has "apple", "Zebra", "app" and a NULL,
# skipped (§2.1): "Z" is 0x5A and "a" 0x61, so MIN is "Zebra"; "app" is a
# prefix of "apple", so MAX is "apple". g = 2 has only "pear". g = 3 has no
# non-NULL value, so both are NULL (§2.2). Types: the input's type (§8.7),
